newsitem.title: UK: Hays to distribute all Courage brands.
newsitem.headline: Hays to distribute all Courage brands.

text.p: UK business services group Hays Plc said on Tuesday it had been appointed sole UK supplier for all Scottish Courage brands from late 1997.
The three-year contract has an annual value of 20 million stg, Hays said in a statement.
The distribution will be done through Hays Distribution, the logistics arm of Hays Plc.
Hays Distribution currently operates four sites at Livingston, Manchester, Newcastle and Westland for Scottish Courage, distributing just under half of its volume.
Hays said it would also integrate the previous Courage operation at Daventry into its network.
Brewer to leisure group Scottish & Newcastle acquired Courage from Australian brewer Fosters in August 1995 for some 550 million stg.
